name: AirPlay Toggle
description:
Quick Settings toggle for PipeWire's AirPlay (RAOP) speaker discovery.

Keeps AirPlay speakers out of your output list until you actually want them, so audio never silently falls back to a network receiver (at full volume) when your monitor sleeps or headphones disconnect.

Requires PipeWire with pipewire-pulse, pactl, and Avahi. On Fedora, also disable the always-on discovery in PipeWire's config - see the README.
